headings: (500 ML) PALO SANTO LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) PALO SANTO LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with a dispenser cap.

Palo Santo | Inspired by a spiritual immersion, a powerful connection to ancestral roots and traditions. A fragrance created with the noblest essence of Palo Santo, enhanced by the spicy touch of black pepper and a delicate veil of violet leaves that complete this unique creation.

Notes:
Top notes: black pepper, hemp.
Heart notes: violet, clove.
Base notes: vetiver, ambergris.
